purpose: A sandbox policy profile for the CentrAlign Operator prototype.

accounts_payable.duplicate_policy: Never create more than one payable for the same source invoice.
accounts_payable.write_policy: Invoices at or above the approval threshold require human approval before a payable is created.
accounts_payable.verification_policy: Read the created payable back from the ledger and compare source invoice, vendor, amount, due date, and status.
